#vanderbilt #utchattanooga #memphis #collegelife #collegefood

#kentucky #louisville #westernkentucky #collegelife #collegefood

Fordham is 2nd 👀 Which Atlantic 10 school has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to your friend at another A-10 school.

#gw #fordham #vcu #collegelife #collegefood

#ucberkeley #michigan #utaustin #collegelife #collegefood

Vanderbilt has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than UT Chattanooga, Memphis and Tennessee combined.

Every Tennessee university with 10,000+ students:

1. Vanderbilt: 129
2. UT Chattanooga: 28
3. Memphis: 26
4. Tennessee: 21
5. East Tennessee State: 18
6. Middle Tennessee State: 9

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/tn

Kentucky has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Louisville, Western Kentucky and Campbellsville combined.

Every Kentucky university with 10,000+ students:

1. Kentucky: 69
2. Louisville: 27
3. Western Kentucky: 19
4. Campbellsville: 15
4. Eastern Kentucky: 15
6. Cumberlands: 9
7. Northern Kentucky: 4

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/ky
